newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock fund reverse flows in 3-day period.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock fund reverse flows in 3-day period.

text.p: U.S. equity mutual funds recorded inflows of $714 million for the three days ended February 27 compared to outflows of $130 million for the two days ended February 24, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

The fund tracking firm said growth funds recorded inflows of $433 million versus outflows of $114 million, growth and income jumped to inflows of $396 million from inflows of $218 million, and international funds increased to $53 million from $14 million.
Bond funds edged up to $48 million from $46 million, with flexible/balanced/mixed up to $117 from $85 million.
Muni funds lowered outflows to $16 million from $90 million.
